definitions.name: Gloom Stalker
definitions.summary: Ranger at home in darkness who ambushes foes before they can react.

definitions.name: Gloom Stalker Magic (3)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Disguise Self.

definitions.name: Gloom Stalker Magic (5)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Rope Trick.

definitions.name: Gloom Stalker Magic (9)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Fear.

definitions.name: Gloom Stalker Magic (13)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Greater Invisibility.

definitions.name: Gloom Stalker Magic (17)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Seeming.

definitions.name: Dread Ambusher
definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to initiative. On your first turn of each combat your speed rises by 10 ft, and if you take the Attack action you make one extra weapon attack that deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type on a hit.

when.text: the extra attack on your first turn of combat

definitions.name: Umbral Sight
definitions.summary: Darkvision 60 ft (or 30 ft more if you already have it). While in darkness you are invisible to creatures that rely on darkvision to see you.

definitions.name: Iron Mind
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Wisdom saving throws; if you already have it, pick Intelligence or Charisma saves instead.

definitions.name: Stalker's Flurry
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

modifiers.label: Stalker's Flurry: on a miss, make another weapon attack (once per turn).

definitions.name: Shadowy Dodge
definitions.summary: Reaction: when a creature attacks you without advantage, impose disadvantage on that attack.

actions.name: Shadowy Dodge
actions.note: An attack against you without advantage: it has disadvantage.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker
definitions.summary: Ranger who guards the world against planar threats and steps between planes.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker Magic (3)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Protection from Evil and Good.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker Magic (5)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Misty Step.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker Magic (9)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Haste.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker Magic (13)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Banishment.

definitions.name: Horizon Walker Magic (17)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Teleportation Circle.

definitions.name: Detect Portal
definitions.summary: Action, once per short or long rest: learn the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal within 1 mile.

actions.name: Detect Portal
actions.note: Sense the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile.

definitions.name: Planar Warrior
definitions.summary: Bonus action: pick a creature within 30 ft. Your next hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus an extra 1d8 force (2d8 from 11th level).

actions.name: Planar Warrior
actions.note: Choose a creature within 30 ft: your next hit on it this turn deals force damage plus extra dice.

when.text: first hit this turn on the creature marked with Planar Warrior (all the damage becomes force)

definitions.name: Ethereal Step
definitions.summary: Bonus action, once per short or long rest: step into the Ethereal Plane until the end of the turn, as the etherealness spell.

actions.name: Ethereal Step
actions.note: Become ethereal until the end of this turn.

definitions.name: Distant Strike
definitions.summary: With the Attack action you can teleport up to 10 ft before each attack, and if you attack at least two different creatures you get one more attack against a third.

modifiers.label: Distant Strike: teleport 10 ft before each attack; hit two different creatures to earn an attack on a third.

definitions.name: Spectral Defense
definitions.summary: Reaction: when an attack damages you, you gain resistance to all of that attack's damage.

actions.name: Spectral Defense
actions.note: An attack damages you: resistance to all its damage this turn.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer
definitions.summary: Ranger who hunts vampires, dragons and other supernatural threats.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer Magic (3)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Protection from Evil and Good.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer Magic (5)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Zone of Truth.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer Magic (9)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Magic Circle.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer Magic (13)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Banishment.

definitions.name: Monster Slayer Magic (17)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Hold Monster.

definitions.name: Hunter's Sense
definitions.summary: Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest (at least once): learn a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, if it isn't shielded from divination.

actions.name: Hunter's Sense
actions.note: One creature within 60 ft: learn its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities.

definitions.name: Slayer's Prey
definitions.summary: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 ft. The first time each turn you hit it with a weapon attack it takes an extra 1d6. Lasts until a short or long rest or until you mark another creature.

actions.name: Slayer's Prey
actions.note: Mark a creature within 60 ft: +1d6 on your first weapon hit on it each turn.

when.text: first hit this turn on your marked target

definitions.name: Supernatural Defense
definitions.summary: When your Slayer's Prey target forces you to make a save, or you check to escape its grapple, add 1d6 to the roll.

when.text: your Slayer's Prey target forced the save
escaping your Slayer's Prey target's grapple
escaping your Slayer's Prey target's grapple

definitions.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
definitions.summary: Reaction, once per short or long rest: when you see a creature within 60 ft cast a spell or teleport, it makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC or the spell or teleport fails and is wasted.

actions.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
actions.note: A creature within 60 ft casts or teleports: Wisdom save or it fails and is wasted.

definitions.name: Slayer's Counter
definitions.summary: Reaction: when your Slayer's Prey target forces you to save, make one weapon attack against it; if it hits, you also succeed on the save.

actions.name: Slayer's Counter
actions.note: Your marked target forces a save: attack it once; a hit also makes your save succeed.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer
definitions.summary: Ranger touched by the Feywild who mixes fey charm with mind-scarring strikes.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer Magic (3)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Charm Person.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer Magic (5)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Misty Step.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer Magic (9)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Dispel Magic.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer Magic (13)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Dimension Door.

definitions.name: Fey Wanderer Magic (17)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Mislead.

definitions.name: Dreadful Strikes
definitions.summary: When you hit a creature with a weapon you can add 1d4 psychic damage (1d6 from 11th level); each creature can take this only once per turn.

when.text: this creature hasn't taken Dreadful Strikes damage this turn

definitions.name: Otherworldly Glamour
definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier (at least +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

definitions.name: Beguiling Twist
definitions.summary: Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Reaction when you or a creature within 120 ft succeeds on such a save: another creature within 120 ft makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened (your pick) for 1 minute.

actions.name: Beguiling Twist
actions.note: A save against charm or fear succeeds nearby: another creature within 120 ft makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute.

definitions.name: Fey Reinforcements
definitions.summary: You know Summon Fey (not counted against spells known), can cast it once per long rest without a slot, and can choose to cast it without concentration (then it lasts 1 minute).

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.casting: always known; free once per long rest

definitions.name: Misty Wanderer
definitions.summary: Cast Misty Step without a slot a number of times per long rest equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once), and bring one willing creature within 5 ft along.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.casting: always known; free uses per long rest

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper
definitions.summary: Ranger bonded to a swarm of nature spirits that harries foes and carries the ranger.

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper Magic (3)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Mage Hand, Faerie Fire.

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper Magic (5)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Web.

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper Magic (9)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Gaseous Form.

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper Magic (13)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Arcane Eye.

definitions.name: Swarmkeeper Magic (17)
definitions.summary: Always known, and they don't count against your ranger spells known: Insect Plague.

definitions.name: Gathered Swarm
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns after you hit a creature with an attack, your swarm either deals an extra 1d6 piercing, pushes the target 15 ft (Strength save), or moves you 5 ft. Mighty Swarm improves all three at 11th level.

when.text: you choose the swarm's damage option
you choose the swarm's damage option

actions.name: Gathered Swarm
actions.note: Once per turn after a hit.

definitions.name: Writhing Tide
definitions.summary: Bonus action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: for 1 minute you gain a 10-ft flying speed and can hover.

definitions.name: Mighty Swarm
definitions.summary: Gathered Swarm gets stronger: its damage becomes 1d8, a pushed creature can also be knocked prone, and moving yourself also gives you half cover until your next turn.

definitions.name: Swarming Dispersal
definitions.summary: Reaction, proficiency bonus times per long rest: when you take damage, gain resistance to it and teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see.

actions.name: Swarming Dispersal
actions.note: You take damage: resistance to it, then teleport up to 30 ft.

definitions.name: Drakewarden
definitions.summary: A ranger bonded to a draconic spirit that takes form as a drake, growing from a small companion into a winged mount.

definitions.name: Draconic Gift
definitions.summary: You learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip (a ranger spell for you), and Draconic or another language of your choice.

definitions.name: Drake Companion
definitions.summary: Action: summon your drake within 30 ft, choosing its essence (acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison). It uses your proficiency bonus and takes its turn right after yours, taking the Dodge action unless you command it with a bonus action. It stays until it drops to 0 hit points, you summon it again, or you die. Free once per long rest, or spend a spell slot of 1st level or higher.

actions.name: Command drake
actions.note: Your drake takes an action from its stat block, or another action; otherwise it Dodges.

companions.name: Drake
companions.combatNote: Takes its turn right after yours. It moves and uses its reaction on its own; it takes the Dodge action unless you spend a bonus action to command it. If you're incapacitated it acts as it likes.

summon.note: Summoning takes your action: free once per long rest, or with a spell slot of 1st level or higher. Choose its essence each time; it arrives with all its hit points.

traits.name: Draconic Essence
traits.summary: Its essence is acid: it's immune to acid damage. You pick the essence each time you summon it.

traits.name: Infused Strikes
traits.summary: Reaction: when another creature within 30 ft that it can see hits a target with a weapon attack, that target takes an extra 1d6 acid damage.

traits.name: Drake Mount
traits.summary: You can ride it if you're Medium or smaller; while you ride it, it can't use its flying speed.

traits.name: Magic Fang
traits.summary: Its Bite deals an extra 1d6 acid damage. While it's out, you resist acid damage.

traits.name: Large Drake
traits.summary: It can fly while you ride it.

traits.name: Empowered Bite
traits.summary: Its Bite deals another 1d6 acid damage (2d6 extra in all).

definitions.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
definitions.summary: Your drake grows wings (flying speed equal to its walking speed) and becomes Medium; you can ride it if you're Medium or smaller (it can't fly while ridden). Its Bite deals an extra 1d6 damage of its essence, and while it's out you resist that damage type.

definitions.name: Drake's Breath
definitions.summary: Action: you or your drake exhale a 30-ft cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (any of them, not just its essence). Dexterity save against your spell save DC: 8d6 damage on a fail, half on a success (10d6 at 15th level). Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher.

actions.name: Drake's Breath
actions.note: 30-ft cone, from you or your drake. Or spend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher instead.

definitions.name: Perfected Bond
definitions.summary: Your drake becomes Large and can fly while you ride it, and its Bite deals another 1d6 of its essence (2d6 extra in all). Reflexive Resistance: when you or the drake takes damage while you're within 30 ft of each other, your reaction gives that one resistance to it; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

actions.name: Reflexive Resistance
actions.note: You or your drake (within 30 ft of each other) resist this instance of damage.
